payload.title: Main (main) Notebook
payload.description: This notebook generates all of the figures from the manuscript, Cropper et al., (2023). It processes climate model data and paleoclimate reconstructions to produce visualizations and analyze emergent constraints.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and set up plot styles.
steps.title: Setup and Library Imports

steps.description: Generate Figure 1 to show how the proposed emergent relationships fare in CMIP5 and CMIP6 ensembles.
steps.title: Figure 1: Emergent Relationships in CMIP5 and CMIP6

steps.description: Generate Figure 2 to compare models to one paleoclimate reconstruction over the last millennium.
steps.title: Figure 2: Model Comparison to Paleoclimate Reconstruction

steps.description: Generate Figure 3 to show the emergent constraint for temperature variability metrics in the paleomodel ensemble.
steps.title: Figure 3: Emergent Constraint for Temperature Variability

steps.description: Generate Figure 4 to show the emergent constraint produced by each relationship from the last millennium.
steps.title: Figure 4: Emergent Constraint from Last Millennium
